## Delivered behavior

Migration041 (`20261026224004_organization_commands.sql`):100tables/1036columns/134public functions. Five forced-RLS/raw-denied tables hold the term control spine, permanent unit aliases, identity-only merge links, immutable structural changes and original work-unit references. Three public RPCs read, preview and explicitly publish allowlisted organization changes. Current admin.configure AND roles.manage plus core/workspace authority; writes require active term. Expected version/current impact fingerprint, exact actor-key-payload retry and transactional audit/outbox prevent blind overwrite/partial publication. Metadata retains structural old/new values without copying private profiles/case payloads/roster emails.

/admin now supports unit add/edit/rename/archive/merge, approved roster add/edit and dated scoped deployment add/edit/revoke, current active ownership/contact display, scoped impact/reviewer/access-effect preview and publication history. Unit code/name aliases and UUID deep links survive rename; original tracking IDs, request receiving units and historic private records remain unchanged. Merge copies no deployment/role/record grant or protected content. Suspensions, shortened authority and archive/removal with unresolved ownership/reviewer/service obligations are explicitly blocked. Self-administrator removal is refused; role-management custody remains separate.

Explicit ordinary deliverable remapping reuses the existing update_deliverable authorization/version/snapshot path, with current authority for both units and named owner. An immutable origin reference preserves the original unit. Restricted/governed, finance/publicity-linked, child/synergy work remains on its authorized workflow and blocks unsafe unit archival. There is no bulk private-case migration or manufactured approver.

P33_A3 uses **refusal before archive/removal**, retaining current unit/deployment/case state and displaying blockers. It does not claim a mass case-freeze or automatic replacement. New roster entries have no auth linkage, invitation or implicit role. Optional affiliation/course/private sharing cannot be overridden. Current role labels/deployments do not supply institutional FIN/feedback/MCD authority. A deployment can activate an existing role only through the explicit reviewed publication.
